findings.description: The phrase "refresh ... only while" restricts when refreshes may occur but does not require a refresh or specify its frequency. A controller that never refreshes the independent watchdog could satisfy this wording, despite the 100 ms timeout in CON-SUP-106 and the servicing intent in STK-SUP-005.
findings.requested_change: Specify when or how often the independent watchdog must be refreshed during fault-free operation, using the supported timeout and identifying any missing input needed to define the rule.
